remediation.issue: The skill does not define prerequisites or permission boundaries for Trello sync.
remediation.suggestion: Document required CLI setup, Trello authentication, target board selection, and dry-run review before syncing.

content.user_title: Plan Trello Workflows with BPSAI Pair
content.value_statement: Teams lose time when plans, tasks, and Trello boards use different structures. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a simple Trello planning workflow.
actual_capabilities: Defines a seven-list Trello board structure for planning and delivery.
Standardizes card titles with stack labels and task names.
Maps task effort to small, medium, and large labels.
Defines stack labels for frontend, backend, workers, bugs, and AI work.
Provides bpsai-pair commands for creating plans and syncing them to Trello.
Lists commands for checking plans, plan status, Trello sync, and plan tasks.
limitations: Requires the bpsai-pair CLI to be installed and configured.
Does not provide Trello authentication or board setup instructions.
Does not execute task lifecycle steps directly.
Cannot verify Trello board state without access to the configured tools.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Feature Sprint
use_cases.description: Turn a feature idea into planned tasks with clear list placement, effort labels, and acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Sync Engineering Work
use_cases.description: Create a plan with bpsai-pair and preview Trello changes before moving cards into Planned/Ready.

use_cases.title: Organize Technical Debt
use_cases.description: Classify bugs, improvements, and operations notes into consistent Trello lists for later prioritization.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the planning-with-trello workflow to outline a Trello-ready plan for this feature: [feature summary]. Include card titles, labels, and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Break Down a Sprint
prompt_templates.prompt: Break this sprint goal into 1-2 day Trello tasks using the seven-list workflow: [sprint goal]. Suggest effort and stack labels.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Trello Sync
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the bpsai-pair plan steps for [plan name]. Include a dry-run sync review and ask before any non-dry-run Trello sync.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this plan against the planning-with-trello rules: [plan details]. Identify missing labels, oversized tasks, unclear acceptance criteria, and risky sync steps.

output_examples.input: Plan a billing settings feature for Trello.
output_examples.output: A Trello-ready plan with frontend, backend, and review tasks. Each task includes an effort label, acceptance criteria, and a target list.

output_examples.input: Prepare a dry-run sync for the current sprint plan.
output_examples.output: A concise sync checklist that starts with a dry run, reviews the target list, and asks for confirmation before updating Trello.

output_examples.input: Organize bug fixes and technical debt for next week.
output_examples.output: A grouped Trello plan that separates bugs, improvements, and operations notes while keeping each card small enough for short execution.

best_practices: Run a dry-run Trello sync before any board update.
Keep tasks small enough to complete in one or two days.
Use consistent stack and effort labels on every card.
anti_patterns: Syncing to Trello before reviewing the target list.
Creating vague cards without acceptance criteria.
Using one large card for work that spans several days.

faq.question: Does this skill connect directly to Trello?
faq.answer: No. It documents a workflow that uses the bpsai-pair CLI to sync plans with Trello.

faq.question: Can it create a new plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides the plan creation command and guidance for task breakdown.

faq.question: Should I run sync commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. Preview with dry-run first and confirm the target list before syncing.

faq.question: What board structure does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects seven lists, including backlog, planned work, progress, review, done, issues, and notes.

faq.question: Does it define task labels?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines effort labels and stack labels for common engineering work.

faq.question: Can it manage task execution?
faq.answer: Only partially. It points to a separate task lifecycle skill for starting and completing work.
